artifactType: Backlog 2 Batch 033 staged manual extraction input
scope: Fixed membership S3518, S3873, S3881, S3896, S3953 only
modelNote: The skill-default GPT-5.5 runner was not selectable in this delegated workspace; the available local GPT-5 Codex model was used.

preApply.protectedScreening: Each record has two immutable full-text include votes, a ready_for_extraction resolution, and a promotion link. No screening-record, vote, resolution, or promotion write is staged.

checks: Each attached primary PDF was inspected once in full, including all results tables and usable figures; each local SHA-256 matches papers.primary_file_sha256.
Population layouts were selected before field staging: S3881 Total and S3953 Total. The other three fixed records have no compatible extraction population.

S3881 is a prospective FIFA Women's World Cup surveillance cohort with direct player-hour/player-day denominators. Tabs 1-10 were swept: Tables 1-2 provide direct time-loss injury location/tissue metrics; the results text provides all-injury, illness, onset, recurrence, and exposure values.

S3953 is a prospective male-football cohort with directly published non-contact lower-limb rates per 1000 athlete-hours. Tabs 1-8 were swept: Table 4 and Figure 5 provide source-supported injury values; no illness data is reported. Exposure totals were not back-calculated from the rates.
S3518 is a longitudinal depression/anxiety questionnaire study with no injury or illness surveillance outcome, so its true mental_health exclusion remains appropriate.

S3873 is a cross-sectional self-reported previous-season injury-history study. It reports headcounts and recalled injury categories only; regular current participation and weekly sessions are not a study-specific at-risk exposure denominator. It is staged for flagged status with flag_reason No exposure - exclude and no extraction payload.
S3896 is a cross-sectional questionnaire study of 156 active soccer main referees, not football players. It is staged for referee status and no extraction payload.

All staged field IDs are schema-defined. Structured values are dual-written through population sync, and aggregation is limited to transparent same-denominator sums: S3953 muscle injury (groin/hamstring/quadriceps/unspecified thigh strains), thigh (hamstring/quadriceps/unspecified thigh), and knee (meniscus/other knee) count/rate rows. No CIs, means, total exposure, or recurrence total are derived.

classifications.caveat: Longitudinal CES-D/GAD-7 symptom study; injuries are contextual discussion examples, not measured injury or illness outcomes.

Cross-sectional self-reported injury history lacks a usable at-risk exposure denominator; reported weekly sessions and prior-season injury groupings cannot support a defensible rate or exposure derivation.
Time-loss injury location/tissue rows are source-supported. Contact and player-action data are restricted to the sudden-onset subset and are deliberately not placed in all-injury count fields.
Active main referees are not current football-player participants; psychological questionnaire outcomes do not support GBI extraction.

The paper publishes rates but not raw total/match/training exposure, so exposure is blank. Its Table 4 Total reinjury cell is 0 despite direct row-level reinjury entries totalling 7; no recurrence total is staged pending source clarification.
